verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents official Datadog SDKs: no SDK listing, language coverage, or SDK docs page appears. The API Reference (docs-24) is only a page title for a raw API, and datadog-ci (probe-4) is a CLI, not an SDK. The only SDK mention is a community note that no Datadog SDK exists for Elixir/Erlang, which records a gap rather than documenting a capability, so the story's axis applies but has no supporting evidence.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
